verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform, and such a product could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside Modal that users can delegate tasks to. The official skill for external coding agents and the llms.txt docs only help third-party agents use Modal, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
